Enter the Dojo#001.src: Oh hohoho! So a human has found their way to my humble dojo? Intriguing! I am called Sensei Miyagi. I welcome you.
Enter the Dojo#001.speaker: Sensei Miyagi

Enter the Dojo#002.src: This dojo- I have dedicated to honing skills in all of the arts- from mental prowess and mental acuity, to craftsmanship and artistry.
Enter the Dojo#002.speaker: Sensei Miyagi

Enter the Dojo#003.src: Many have come- traveled from all corners of the earth to this humble one's dojo to train themselves and grow stronger. I am to presume you are the same?
Enter the Dojo#003.speaker: Sensei Miyagi

Enter the Dojo#004.src: Although, while I have enjoyed my life's work here, I cannot deny I am getting on in years. I seek a successor, a master of many skills to take my place.
Enter the Dojo#004.speaker: Sensei Miyagi

Enter the Dojo#005.src: To the one who should master the arts, I would bequeath the Master's Gi, a symbol of resolute skill. Of course, do not feel pressured to take over for me, hoho!
Enter the Dojo#005.speaker: Sensei Miyagi

Enter the Dojo#006.src: As long as I may teach others and bring them to new heights, I am satisfied. Whether your aim be merely to sharpen your skills or to allow me to retire, you are welcomed.
Enter the Dojo#006.speaker: Sensei Miyagi

Enter the Dojo#007.src: When you are ready to begin, purify yourself in the waters of the spring behind the dojo, and I will guide you to your first challenge.
Enter the Dojo#007.speaker: Sensei Miyagi

Enter the Dojo#008.src: Jump down the water pit to begin the challenges.

Enter the Dojo#009.src: Ascend the Lufar Room in the physical strength challenge.

Enter the Dojo#010.src: Here we are then- The Lufar Room. Here tests your agility! Even these old bones can scale this room in short order- how shall you fare?
Enter the Dojo#010.speaker: Sensei Miyagi

Enter the Dojo#011.src: Fight your way through the Fiata Room in the combat challenge.

Enter the Dojo#012.src: I recognize your skill, and you have passed the challenge of the Lufar Room! Hoho, but the next challenge has defeated many an apprentice.
Enter the Dojo#012.speaker: Sensei Miyagi

Enter the Dojo#013.src: Now, comes the Fiata Room! Here, your combat prowess shall be put to the test. Martial skill comes easily to me...but what of your own?
Enter the Dojo#013.speaker: Sensei Miyagi

Enter the Dojo#014.src: I hear many things about human combat skill, so I believe I shall watch this challenger myself. Enter now, challenger!
Enter the Dojo#014.speaker: Sensei Miyagi

Enter the Dojo#015.src: Solve the puzzle of sight in the Cliste Room in the sight challenge.

Enter the Dojo#016.src: And I am to recognize your combat skill, and to proclaim your passage of the Fiata Room. Well done!
Enter the Dojo#016.speaker: Sensei Miyagi

Enter the Dojo#017.src: Next, however, is not a challenge of physical skill, but of observation and logical reasoning, in this- the Cliste Room. Here, a puzzle awaits.
Enter the Dojo#017.speaker: Sensei Miyagi

Enter the Dojo#018.src: You must discern the path in order to bring the red block to the gold block. Simple in theory...complex in practice, as there are many things.
Enter the Dojo#018.speaker: Sensei Miyagi

Enter the Dojo#019.src: Remember this as you work- Change your perspective, and the reality changes.
Enter the Dojo#019.speaker: Sensei Miyagi

Enter the Dojo#020.src: Become at one with nature in the Sitheach Room and Cavern.

Enter the Dojo#021.src: And there, I recognize your mental acuity! You have passed the Cliste Room. You are doing quite well, but many have gotten to this point and had a single point stymie them.
Enter the Dojo#021.speaker: Sensei Miyagi

Enter the Dojo#022.src: Welcome then, to the last challenge I offer you, held within the Sitheach Room and cavern.
Enter the Dojo#022.speaker: Sensei Miyagi

Enter the Dojo#023.src: Your task here, is to become tranquil, and at peace with nature. What that entails... I leave up to you.
Enter the Dojo#023.speaker: Sensei Miyagi

Enter the Dojo#024.src: There are many paths to tranquility. Whatever you choose, you will know when you have reached the point of success.
Enter the Dojo#024.speaker: Sensei Miyagi

Enter the Dojo#025.src: Exit the Sitheach cave through the tunnel near the temple.

Enter the Dojo#027.src: I see it now. The troubled heart you came here with is troubled no longer. I recognize your mastery of the Sitheach Room.
Enter the Dojo#027.speaker: Sensei Miyagi

Enter the Dojo#028.src: Oh hoho... It is just like a human to do what cannot be done. That is each challenge of my humble dojo, completed!
Enter the Dojo#028.speaker: Sensei Miyagi

Enter the Dojo#029.src: So! While I did advise you not to feel pressured of it, I am curious, young master. Do you wish to take my place here, so I may sit these old bones down?
Enter the Dojo#029.speaker: Sensei Miyagi

Enter the Dojo#030.src: Ah, of course not. Despite your mastery, this is merely a single step on your journey. Needn't worry, I understand completely.
Enter the Dojo#030.speaker: Sensei Miyagi

Enter the Dojo#031.src: I am certain that I will find a suitable successor before my time comes- and equally as certain that I've many a year to go, hoho!
Enter the Dojo#031.speaker: Sensei Miyagi

Enter the Dojo#032.src: Nevertheless, you have completed the challenges of this humble Sensei, as such, I will provide you what was promised.
Enter the Dojo#032.speaker: Sensei Miyagi

Enter the Dojo#033.src: Wear this [Master's Gi] with pride, and remember this final lesson- There is never a point in life that you will stop learning. See the world and its lessons every day of your life, young master.
Enter the Dojo#033.speaker: Sensei Miyagi
